instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot from a low angle. Inside a studio with a red carpet and dark wall panels, the bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands in the foreground with his back to the camera, balancing on his left leg while kicking his right leg backward. In the background, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands watching him. The scene is illuminated by overhead studio lights.
